llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金的选区激光熔化，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no fatigue or osseointegration testing; aluminum alloys are not typical for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化制备高硅铝合金的微观结构和磨损行为
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备不同硅含量的铝合金，进行微观结构和磨损实验
summary_zh.result: 细化了微观组织，提高了耐磨性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and wear behavior of hypereutectic Al-high Si alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to produce Al-high Si alloys with varying Si content, followed by microstructure characterization and wear testing.
summary_en.result: The SLM process refined the microstructure and improved wear resistance compared to conventional casting.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through wear tests and microstructural analysis.
